actual_cards.name: Rest in Peace
actual_cards.oracle_text:
When this enchantment enters, exile all graveyards.
If a card or token would be put into a graveyard from anywhere, exile it instead.
actual_cards.provenance: Scryfall metadata mirror (METADATA_ONLY); official Oracle via Gatherer pending Coordinator check. Chosen because it is the minimal replacement-mediated zone-change dogfood: a destroy event becomes exile. No simpler card isolates destroy-to-exile replacement.

ZONE_IDENTITY: exiled card is a new object with no graveyard history (falsifies identity-carryover)
NATIVE_IDENTITY: exile binding must reference the post-replacement object
rules_provenance: Oracle text (replacement sentence) applied to a destroy event; zone-identity consequences per standard zone-change identity handling. CR section mapping proposed in Rules Authority packet; MECHANICALLY_DERIVED hypothesis, not independently validated.
semantic_objective: Prove the engine applies Rest in Peace as a replacement (not a trigger, not prevention): Doom Blade destroying a creature exiles it directly, fires no dies triggers, and touches no graveyard.
title: Rest in Peace replaces destroy with exile
